# Fairpointe

> Fairpointe is a UK technology company helping organisations adopt specialist cloud, security and AI technology and helping international technology companies enter the UK market.

Contact: adebola@fairpointe.co.uk

## Pages

- [Home](https://fairpointe.co.uk/): Enterprise technology, delivered in the UK.
- [AI & Security](https://fairpointe.co.uk/ai-security): AI agent and non-human identity security across AWS, Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Entra, GitHub, Kubernetes, SaaS applications and MCP infrastructure. Approach: discover, govern, control, monitor.
- [Cloud & Infrastructure](https://fairpointe.co.uk/cloud-infrastructure): Cloud architecture, platform engineering, cloud security, infrastructure automation, migration and modernisation across AWS and Microsoft Azure.
- [UK Market Entry](https://fairpointe.co.uk/uk-market-entry): A UK commercial and technical partner for international enterprise technology companies. Five phases: understand the market, build pipeline, close, deploy, grow.
- [Public Sector](https://fairpointe.co.uk/public-sector): Technology delivery for UK public services across cloud and infrastructure, AI and automation, security, data and software implementation.
- [About](https://fairpointe.co.uk/about): Built by operators. Led by Adebola Adeniran.
- [Contact](https://fairpointe.co.uk/contact): Enquiries about technology projects, UK market entry, public sector, AI and security, or cloud and infrastructure.
